name: Oft-Nabbed Goat
oracle_text:
{1}: Draw a card. Gain control of this creature and put a -1/-1 counter on it. Only your opponents may activate this ability and only as a sorcery.
When this creature dies, if it had one or more -1/-1 counters on it, its owner draws that many cards and each other player loses that much life.
blocked_sentences: {1}: Draw a card. Gain control of this creature and put a -1/-1 counter on it. Only your opponents may activate this ability and only as a sorcery.

needs.what: an activated ability on a permanent that players other than its controller may activate ("Only your opponents may activate this ability", and the sibling "Any player may activate this ability"), paid for by the activator, with the activator bound as the ability's controller so that 'draw a card' and 'gain control of this creature' (gain_control player: the activator) resolve for them, and sorcery timing checked on the activator's turn
needs.why_existing_wont_do: Activated abilities are only offered to the permanent's controller. The only 'activated_by' key in the DSL belongs to the ability_cost_reduction static and the loader refuses it on any other ability ('activated_by only mean anything on an ability_cost_reduction static'); nothing in ability_keys lets an opponent activate an ability of a permanent they do not control.
